summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on organizing specific facilities into clusters. One participant was asked to group three facilities under a cluster and then separate two other sets of data/facilities for another cluster.

Regarding analytics, it was noted that tabs would be created automatically, but visibility is restricted to users with the 'mall' role. A discussion ensued about identifying users who do not currently see the mall dashboard, requiring either their emails or the associated company name if the role needs to be assigned broadly.
decisions: Three facilities will be grouped under a specific cluster.
Two additional clusters/sets of data need tabs added to Mall Analytics.
action_items: The participant who knows how to set up roles will handle the assignment of 'mall' role visibility for users.
Identify and provide emails or company names of users lacking access to the mall dashboard.
